status: preregistered: frozen by the pull request that adds PREREGISTRATION.md; canary_rig is set by the dated amendment described there
canary_rig_rule: scripts/canary/run.sh refuses unless HEAD is this commit. A rig change is a dated amendment that sets a new commit and resets the previous-screened baseline; the release under test is the only thing that moves.

gstack.release: head of the stable branch, version from the VERSION file at that commit
gstack.moves: v* tags in previous..new along stable

gbrain.release: peeled commit of the stable tag, version from the stable-v* tag on that commit or the VERSION file

install_route.claude-code: gbrain installer, told-scoped, for Claude Code

T2.when: every 30 days per product, and at once after a T1 or safety flag

T3.when: after a T2 pass-rate, cost or safety flag
T3.bisect: when more than one stable move lies in range, T3-size comparisons on the flagged model, first bad release by binary search

leases.note: re-priced 2026-11-09: the mean home-cell cost per task from the task lists' source receipts, particle-1 at half of Sol's (gbrain T1 smoke), times 1.6 for every arm (the largest product-to-plain cost ratio in the two T1 smokes was 1.57), plus room for one worst-case call reservation (the metering proxy refuses a call whose worst case, $7.89 for Opus 5.5 in Claude Code, does not fit the lease), rounded up to the next $5; every tier reserves its estimate and settles to the metered spend

schedule.automation: nightly 01:30 America/Los_Angeles, at most one run a day; created disabled, enabled after its first manual run passes (internal-task, 2026-11-09)

alerts.to: internal-task, word for word, by the nightly automation
alerts.digest: improvements on the digest tasks go into a weekly digest line, never an alert
alerts.format: docs/canary.md, section The alert; printed by scripts/canary/run.sh between CANARY_ALERT_BEGIN and CANARY_ALERT_END

receipts.branch: canary-receipts (orphan, never merged, exported or opened as a pull request)
receipts.drive: the coordinating agent's drive, canary/runs/<run id>/ (verdict.json, alert.md, summary.md)
receipts.public: only this preregistration and the baseline results go through pull requests
